"""Artificial masking arithmetic only; this is not the later neural model."""

import numpy as _batch_np


def artificial_masked_mean(token_ids, mask, embedding_table):
    """Check the intended pooling equation on supplied toy vectors."""
    ids = _batch_np.asarray(token_ids)
    positions = _batch_np.asarray(mask)
    vectors = _batch_np.asarray(embedding_table, dtype=_batch_np.float64)
    if (ids.ndim != 2 or not ids.size or ids.dtype.kind not in ("i", "u")
            or positions.shape != ids.shape or positions.dtype.kind != "b"
            or vectors.ndim != 2 or not vectors.size or not _batch_np.isfinite(vectors).all()
            or (ids < 0).any() or (ids >= len(vectors)).any()
            or not _batch_np.array_equal(positions, ids != 0)):
        raise ValueError("Invalid artificial pooling inputs.")
    lengths = positions.sum(axis=1)
    if (lengths < 1).any():
        raise ValueError("All-padding rows have no valid pooling denominator.")
    selected = vectors[ids]
    sums = _batch_np.where(positions[..., None], selected, 0.0).sum(axis=1)
    return {"means": (sums / lengths[:, None]).tolist(), "lengths": lengths.tolist()}
